scope: Offline workbench, actual Worker, DOM and WebGL; no full React claim

tests.name: Default auto-load exposes geometry-only policy and never retains original UV
UI cannot request original-UV inspection, hints, or recovery
Generate baseline default reconstructs both gear faces and holes from geometry
Actual baseline button repeats exactly the default-loaded UV result
Imported random original UV cannot affect the auto-load result
Current generated result can be repacked with provenance preserved
Fill operates on current generated islands without requesting source UV
Pipeline reports geometry generation and explicit skipped fill, not original extraction
Real UV clicks remain island first, then face, then face deselect
Area-priority queue and speeds remain available
Actual RAF playback preserves camera and restores context when paused
Bundled corset button runs real geometry-only Worker without network
Bundled flight-helmet button runs real geometry-only Worker without network
No JavaScript or WebGL errors remain
